limits: Factual binding only: no legal, compliance, notarization or release decision. release_accepted is always false.
Relations prove that signing changed only code signatures, digest fields, receipt artifact bindings and the seal; they never create material coverage.
Initial-review facts carry only through verified relations from the original artifact digests they were reviewed against.
Delivery materials are bound by digest; how and where they are offered to recipients is part of the reviewed component materials.

The extractor route is typed: the stock route carries no source evidence, and the controlled-source route is re-proven from the input producer bytes, its digest-bound evidence, kit, compiled bootloader and preparation report on every prepare and verify.

Source evidence is a digest root of trust, not a legal, source or materials acceptance; compilation from the kit sources, source and terms sufficiency, and runtime capability stay build and review evidence. Component statuses come only from the reviewed final input.
